articles.title: How to make an AMC or subscription contract
articles.summary: Write an AMC or subscription contract on Nivesh Sahayak: service covered, term, billing period, amount, GST, advance or arrears, visits, then print the billing schedule.

articles.title: Invoices to make, renewals, visits and unpaid
articles.summary: Use the lists of the Nivesh Sahayak AMC tool: make each period’s invoice, renew contracts, tick service visits done, see unpaid invoices, send WhatsApp texts.
